headline: 123 Have The Numbers On test4
deck: 123 lead test4 36-25 with one man each left, the arithmetic all but done
body:
123 hold 36 to test4's 25, and with a single player outstanding on either side the eleven-point gap is more than the round has left to give. One name apiece cannot close it, barring the absurd, and the absurd does not usually oblige.

test4 need a haul and a blank to run alongside it, and the odds of both are the odds you do not build a comeback on. Football has embarrassed better pundits than this page, and we file it as a call, not a result: the wire settles nothing until it settles. But the men left do not stretch the sum far enough.
